item.title: Prompt Engineering Fundamentals
item.description:

Agenda

  1. Opening — framing the problem and what you will walk away with
  2. Core concepts — the ideas everything else rests on
  3. Hands-on — working through it yourself
  4. Common failure modes — what goes wrong and how to spot it early
  5. Where to go next — extending this without it collapsing
What should I already know?
  • You have used an AI coding tool at least once. Any tool is fine.
  • You can read code, even if you do not write much of it.
How do I prepare?
  • Claude Code installed and working. Run it once beforehand to confirm your setup.
  • One idea to work the process against. A sentence is plenty.
What do I need to attend?

Everything runs in your browser. There is nothing to install just to join.
